peers.name: hyperframes
peers.description: Read first to make, edit, animate or render any video with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video), including launch films, explainers, music videos, charts, maps, vertical clips, title cards, captions and overlays. Holds the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.

peers.name: hyperframes-cli
peers.description: HyperFrames CLI - scaffold, check frames, edit timelines, preview, render, share and project history; read JSON and recover from failures.

peers.name: media-use
peers.description: Get or make any media for a HyperFrames video - music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar and generated video, transcripts, cutouts, colour grades and looks - with HeyGen or free local tools, and mix placed audio. Also for footage that looks dark, flat or dull, or should be stylized or hidden.

peers.name: hyperframes-registry
peers.description: About 450 ready-made HyperFrames blocks and components installed as editable source - transitions, overlays, titles, kinetic type, captions, charts, map overlays, 3D, camera moves. Use it before hand-building any named visual (CRT scanlines, glitch, film grain, a chart); also for hyperframes add and catalog.

en.tagline: Rebuild a video as an editable HyperFrames project
en.summary: Rebuilds an existing video as a HyperFrames project whose render is checked against the original frame by frame. It covers motion graphics, talking heads, live action and AI-generated footage. The result stays editable, so text, layers and timing can be changed after the rebuild.
problem: Copying a video by hand means rewatching it many times and guessing at cut points, frame timing, text sizes and motion. Small errors add up, and the copy drifts from the original.

With this skill, the project size, frame rate and duration come from a probe of the original. Cuts are measured by frame, and the final render is diffed against the source. The diff lists missing or extra cuts, duration and sound offset, and the worst mismatched moments.
fit: Recreating a motion graphics or ad video as an editable project
Remaking a talking-head or live-action clip with editable text and layers
Matching the timing and cuts of an AI-generated clip frame by frame
unfit: Remixing a video into something new unless you ask for that
Videos you do not have the right to use
Accounts without HyperFrames Pro, since reverse is a Pro feature
steps: Start with `npx hyperframes reverse start <video> --dir <project>` to probe the video for size, frame rate and duration.
Find every cut with `npx hyperframes measure cuts <video>` and write each shot time from its frame number.
Play the original sound as one audio track under the whole film and mute every clip.
Rebuild text, captions and charts in HTML, cut sub-assets from the original, and re-shoot people with HeyGen.
Check a few moments with `npx hyperframes diff`, then run `check`, a cloud render and a final diff.
Fix the differences you can see, then write a REVERSE.md with what was rebuilt and the last diff numbers.

zh.tagline: 把视频复刻为可编辑的 HyperFrames 项目
zh.summary: 把已有视频重建为 HyperFrames 项目，并把渲染结果与原片逐帧对照。适用于动态图形、口播、实拍和 AI 生成的画面。结果仍可编辑，重建后可以修改文字、图层和时间。
problem: 手动复刻视频需要反复观看，靠猜测确定切点、帧时间、文字大小和运动。小误差会累积，成品与原片逐渐不一致。
使用这个技能后，项目尺寸、帧率和时长由对原片的探测得出，切点按帧测量，最终渲染会与原片做对比。对比结果会列出缺失或多出的切点、时长和声音偏移，以及差异最大的几个时刻。
fit: 把动态图形或广告视频复刻成可编辑的项目
用可编辑的文字和图层重做口播或实拍片段
逐帧匹配 AI 生成视频的时间和切点
unfit: 除非你明确要求，否则不用于把视频改编成新内容
没有 HyperFrames Pro 的账户，因为复刻是 Pro 功能
steps: 先运行 `npx hyperframes reverse start <video> --dir <project>`，探测视频的尺寸、帧率和时长。
用 `npx hyperframes measure cuts <video>` 找出每一个切点，并根据帧号写出每个镜头的开始时间。
把原片声音作为一条音轨铺满整部影片，并将所有片段静音。
用 HTML 重建文字、字幕和图表，从原片中裁出子素材，人物用 HeyGen 重新拍摄。
用 `npx hyperframes diff` 检查几个关键时刻，然后运行 `check`、云端渲染和最终对比。
修正能看出来的差异，然后写一份 REVERSE.md，记录重建内容和最后一次对比的数字。
